SELECT b.id, b.name, b.description, b.cover_resource_id, b.owner_id, b.visibility, CASE WHEN bf.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS favorited FROM mk_board b LEFT JOIN mk_board_recent br ON br.board_id = b.id AND br.user_id = #{param.userId} AND br.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mk_board_favorite bf ON bf.board_id = b.id AND bf.user_id = #{param.userId} AND bf.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mk_board_member bm ON bm.board_id = b.id AND bm.user_id = #{param.userId} AND bm.deleted = 0 WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND ( b.visibility = 1 OR bm.role IS NOT NULL )
AND ( b.name LIKE '%' || #{param.keyword} || '%' OR b.description LIKE '%' || #{param.keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY
br.last_active_time
b.name
b.created_time
ASC
DESC
, b.id DESC

SELECT b.* FROM mk_board b LEFT JOIN mk_board_recent br ON br.board_id = b.id AND br.user_id = #{userId} AND br.deleted = 0 WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND ( b.owner_id = #{userId} OR br.id IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN b.owner_id = #{userId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, CASE WHEN b.owner_id = #{userId} THEN b.updated_time END DESC, br.last_active_time DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT b.id AS board_id, b.name AS board_title, b.cover_resource_id AS cover_id, b.description AS board_desc, bs.id AS section_id, bs.title AS section_title, bs.sort_order AS section_sort, t.id AS task_id, t.task_no AS task_no, t.title AS task_title, t.description AS task_description, t.due_date AS task_due_date, t.priority AS task_priority, t.blocked AS task_blocked, t.sort_order AS task_sort, t.creater_id AS task_creater_id, t.created_time AS task_created_time, t.updated_time AS task_updated_time FROM mk_board b LEFT JOIN mk_board_section bs ON bs.board_id = b.id AND bs.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mk_task t ON t.board_id = b.id AND t.section_id = bs.id AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE b.id = #{id} AND b.deleted = 0 ORDER BY bs.sort_order ASC, bs.id ASC, t.sort_order ASC, t.id ASC
SELECT bm.user_id FROM mk_board_member bm WHERE bm.board_id = #{boardId} AND bm.deleted = 0 ORDER BY bm.joined_time ASC, bm.id ASC
SELECT tag.name FROM mk_task_tag task_tag INNER JOIN mk_tag tag ON tag.id = task_tag.tag_id AND tag.deleted = 0 WHERE task_tag.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY task_tag.id ASC
SELECT refer_user.user_id FROM mk_task_refer_user refer_user WHERE refer_user.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY refer_user.id ASC
